summary.text: Beth Mizell is a Republican member of the Louisiana Senate for District 12, representing St. Tammany, Tangipahoa, Washington, according to the Senate member page.
The Senate biography calls Mizell President Pro Tempore of the Senate.

paragraphs.text: Mizell's Senate biography describes her as a mother, grandmother, businesswoman and cattle rancher who lives in Franklinton, and as a lifelong resident of the Northshore.
It says she has been a business owner for 30 years, spending her career in early childhood education and development.

According to the biography, she has served as a Court Appointed Special Advocate (CASA) for 15 years and is active in the First Baptist Church of Franklinton, Republican Women of Franklinton and the Louisiana Cattlemen's Association.

The Senate member page lists Beth Mizell's committee assignments as Commerce, Consumer Protection and International Affairs (Chair); Education; Judiciary A; Revenue and Fiscal Affairs; Insurance (Ex Officio); Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay; Legislative Audit Advisory Council; Joint Select Committee on Louisiana Economic Recovery; Senate Select Committee on Women and Children (Vice Chair).
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus (Chair); Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus; Northshore Delegation.
